text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A pile of letters arrive for Curren Chan.
They
appear to all be fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! These are all for me? I'm so
happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Bro. Is it okay if I read my
letters here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Big Sis. Is it okay if I read my
letters here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think there might be a few too many to
bring
back to my room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine three boxes full of fan letters
would
indeed take up a bit of space in
her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ♪ Then I'll take my time and
read them
one by one. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are so many letters. Reading them
all is
going to take some time. I should
get her a drink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I boil water and make her some tea.
When I try to
give it to her...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All of the fan letters are here in this
room, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All of the fan letters are here in this
room, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay. I guess that's the last one, then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They're letters from my fans, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I were my fan, I'd want my letter read
as soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I should make an Umastagram
post saying
that I've read them all. Hm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan replies to her fans
with great
speed and detail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm starting to understand why
her fans
love her so much.
